happyPath.initialMessage: I need to create an incident. My laptop is showing a blue screen error every time I open Microsoft Outlook. It started this morning after the Windows update.
happyPath.briefDescription: Blue screen error when opening Microsoft Outlook after Windows update
happyPath.detailedDescription: Since this morning after the automatic Windows update (KB5039211), my laptop shows a Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) with error code KERNEL_DATA_INPAGE_ERROR every time I try to open Microsoft Outlook. Other Office applications like Word and Excel work fine. I have restarted the laptop 3 times but the issue persists. My laptop model is Dell Latitude 5540 running Windows 11. This is blocking my work as I cannot access emails.

longDescription.initialMessage: I need to create an incident. Category: Hardware. Subcategory: Laptop/Desktop.
longDescription.briefDescription: Laptop overheating causing automatic shutdown during video calls and heavy processing tasks
longDescription.detailedDescription: My Dell Latitude 7420 laptop has been experiencing severe overheating issues for the past 3 days. The problem occurs consistently during Microsoft Teams video calls and when running multiple applications simultaneously (Outlook, Chrome with 20+ tabs, SAP). The laptop's internal fan spins at maximum speed, the bottom surface becomes extremely hot to touch, and after approximately 15-20 minutes of heavy use, the system performs an emergency thermal shutdown without any warning. I have already tried cleaning the air vents, updating the BIOS to version 1.15.2, reinstalling the graphics drivers (Intel UHD 630), and placing the laptop on a cooling pad. None of these steps resolved the issue. The laptop was working fine before the last Windows Update on August 10th. This is severely impacting my productivity as I cannot attend video conferences that last more than 15 minutes. My department has an important client presentation tomorrow and I need this fixed urgently. Asset tag: DELL-LAT7420-0847.
